dct_description_sm: These supplemental files are to support the findings in the PhD thesis by Joseph Nowlan that will be available in the University of Guelph Atrium. These files provide Tenacibaculum bacterial genomic information, and data used and garnered during microbiome investigations.
dct_title_s: Supplemental data for: the genomics of Tenacibaculum isolates and investigations of transmission of Tenacibaculosis between salmon species in British Columbia (Canada)
